outcome: disease activity around and during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 96 women with 144 pregnancies who were SLE patients receiving joint care from rheumatologists and gynecologists in two tertiary centers in the Netherlands.
finding: Pregnancy complications were present in this SLE population with low disease activity, irrespective of antiphospholipid antibody status, and complication rates were similar between first and consecutive pregnancies.
gest_age: Pregnancies > 16 weeks gestation; preterm birth and small-for-gestational age infants were outcomes.
